summary: Prompt tối thiểu, blazing-fast và vô hạn tùy chỉnh cho bất kỳ shell nào, viết bằng Rust.
usecases: Customize terminal prompts for daily development workflow.
Provide consistent prompt experience across zsh, bash, fish, and PowerShell.
Enable prompt theming for CI dashboards and live demonstrations.
ideas: Integrate Starship prompt themes into VS Code status bar for unified developer experience.
Build a dynamic theme switcher that adjusts prompt appearance based on time of day or system state.
Create a natural language generator for custom Starship configuration files.
